transcript.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Stevenson's, one of the country's major manufacturers of metal goods.
transcript.zh: 大家早上好，欢迎来到史蒂文森公司，这是全国主要的金属制品制造商之一。

transcript.en: Thank you for choosing us for your two weeks of work experience.
transcript.zh: 感谢你们选择我们进行为期两周的工作体验。

transcript.en: My name is Julia Simmons, and since the beginning of this year I've been the managing director.
transcript.zh: 我的名字是朱莉娅-西蒙斯，从今年年初开始，我就是总经理了。

transcript.en: Stevenson's is quite an old company.
transcript.zh: 史蒂文森公司是一个相当古老的公司。

transcript.en: Like me, the founder, Ronald Stevenson, went into the steel industry when he left school - that was in 1923.
transcript.zh: 像我一样，创始人罗纳德-史蒂文森在离开学校时进入了钢铁行业--那是在1923年。

transcript.en: He set up this company when he finished his apprenticeship, in 1926,
transcript.zh: 他在1926年完成学徒期时成立了这家公司，

transcript.en: although he actually started making plans two years earlier, in 1924.
transcript.zh: 尽管他实际上在两年前就开始制定计划，即1924年。

transcript.en: He was a very determined young man!
transcript.zh: 他是一个非常坚定的年轻人。

transcript.en: Stevenson's long-term plan was to manufacture components for the machine tools industry-although in fact that never came about-
transcript.zh: 史蒂文森的长期计划是为机床行业制造零部件--尽管事实上这从未发生过--

transcript.en: and for the automotive industry, that is, cars and lorries.
transcript.zh: 以及为汽车行业，即汽车和卡车制造零部件。

transcript.en: However, there was a delay of five years before that happened,because shortly before the company went into production,
transcript.zh: 然而，在这之前有五年的延迟，因为在公司投入生产前不久，

transcript.en: Stevenson was given the opportunity to make goods for hospitals and other players in the healthcare industry,so that's what we did for the first five years.
transcript.zh: 史蒂文森得到了为医院和医疗保健行业的其他参与者制造商品的机会。所以这就是我们在最初五年所做的事情。

transcript.en: Over the years, we've expanded the premises considerably-we were lucky that the site is big enough,so moving to a new location has never been necessary.
transcript.zh: 多年来，我们大大地扩大了厂房--我们很幸运，场地足够大，所以从来没有必要搬到一个新的地方。

transcript.en: However, the layout is far from ideal for modern machinery and production methods,
transcript.zh: 然而，对于现代机械和生产方法来说，这里的布局远远不够理想，

transcript.en: so we intend to carry out major refurbishment of this site over the next five years.
transcript.zh: 所以我们打算在未来五年内对这个场地进行重大整修。

transcript.en: I'd better give you some idea of what you'll be doing during your two weeks with us,so you know what to expect.
transcript.zh: 我最好给你们一些关于你们在我们这里的两周内会做什么的想法，这样你就知道该做什么。

transcript.en: Most mornings you'll have a presentation from one of the managers, to learn about their department,starting this morning with research and development.
transcript.zh: 基本每天早上都会有一位部门经理进行演讲，让大家了解各自部门的情况，今天上午从研发部门开始。

transcript.en: And you'll all spend some time in each department,
transcript.zh: 你们将在每个部门花一些时间，

transcript.en: observing what's going on and talking to people - as long as you don't stop them from doing their work altogether!
transcript.zh: 观察正在发生的事情，并与人交谈--只要你们不阻止他们做他们的工作就可以了!

transcript.en: In the past, a teacher from your school has come in at the end of each week to find out how the group were getting on,
transcript.zh: 在过去，你们学校的一位老师会在每周结束时来了解小组的进展情况，

transcript.en: but your school isn't able to arrange that this year.
transcript.zh: 但你们学校今年无法安排了。

transcript.en: OK, now I'll briefly help you to orientate yourselves around the site.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在我将简要地帮助你们熟悉周围的情况。

transcript.en: As you can see, we're in the reception area, which we try to make attractive and welcoming to visitors.
transcript.zh: 正如你们所看到的，我们在接待区，我们努力使接待区对来访者具有吸引力和欢迎性。

transcript.en: There's a corridor running left from here,and if you go along that, the door facing you at the end is the entrance to the coffee room.
transcript.zh: 从这里向左走有一条走廊，如果你沿着走廊走，尽头处面向你的那扇门就是咖啡室的入口。

transcript.en: This looks out onto the main road on one side, and some trees on the other, and that'll be where you meet each morning.
transcript.zh: 这里一边是主干道，另一边是一些树木，这将是你们每天早上见面的地方。

transcript.en: The factory is the very big room on the far side of the site.
transcript.zh: 工厂是场地最边上的那个很大的房间。

transcript.en: Next to it is the warehouse, which can be accessed by lorries going up the road to the turning area at the end.
transcript.zh: 旁边是仓库，卡车可以沿着路走到尽头的转弯处进入。

transcript.en: You can get to the warehouse by crossing to the far side of the courtyard, and then the door is on your right.
transcript.zh: 你可以穿过院子的远端到达仓库，然后门就在你的右边。

transcript.en: Somewhere you'll be keen to find is the staff canteen.
transcript.zh: 你会很想找到的地方是员工食堂。

transcript.en: This is right next to reception. I can confidently say that the food's very good, but the view isn't.
transcript.zh: 这就在接待处旁边。我可以自信地说，这里的食物非常好，但风景却不好。

transcript.en: The windows on one side look onto a corridor and courtyard, which aren't very attractive at all,and on the other onto the access road, which isn't much better.
transcript.zh: 一边的窗户看到的是走廊和院子，一点也不吸引人，另一边是通道，也没好多少。

transcript.en: You'll be using the meeting room quite often, and you'll find it by walking along the corridor to the left of the courtyard,and continuing along it to the end.
transcript.zh: 你会经常使用会议室，你可以沿着庭院左边的走廊走，然后继续走到尽头，就能找到它。

transcript.en: The meeting room is the last one on the right,and I'm afraid there's no natural daylight in the room.
transcript.zh: 会议室是右边的最后一间，恐怕房间里没有自然光。

transcript.en: Then you'll need to know where some of the offices are.
transcript.zh: 然后你需要知道一些办公室的位置。

transcript.en: The human resources department is at the front of this building, so you head to the left along the corridor from reception,
transcript.zh: 人力资源部门在这栋楼的前面，所以你从接待处沿着走廊向左走。

transcript.en: and it's the second room you come to. It looks out onto the main road.
transcript.zh: 这是你来到的第二个房间。从这儿可以看到主路。

transcript.en: And finally, the boardroom, where you'll be meeting sometimes.
transcript.zh: 最后是会议室，你们有时会在这里开会。

transcript.en: That has quite a pleasant view, as it looks out on to the trees.
transcript.zh: 这间房的风景相当不错，因为它可以看到树木。

transcript.en: Go along the corridor past the courtyard, right to the end.
transcript.zh: 沿着走廊经过院子，一直走到尽头。

transcript.en: The boardroom is on the left, next to the factory.
transcript.zh: 董事会办公室在左边，紧挨着工厂。

transcript.en: OK, now are there any questions before we ...
transcript.zh: 好了，现在有什么问题吗，在我们...
